title: mytr
summary: tr(1): translate characters of standard input by position, or delete them with -d.
hints: For the translation, `strchr(from, c)` gives the position `p` of `c` in `from`; the replacement is `to[p - from]`.
Compare `strlen(from)` and `strlen(to)` before reading anything. Careful: `strchr(s, 0)` finds the terminator, so test `c != 0`.
